title: Persona Contact List — payload
description: Enumerate contacts in a context, optionally narrowed to those known by one persona, those the holder starred, those on one of the holder's lists, or those linked to one community's directory. Summaries only, with the holder's annotations; documents are fetched one at a time. Filters combine as AND.

knownByPersona.description: Narrow to contacts known by this persona. Omitting it lists the context's contacts across every persona in it, which a producer SHOULD offer deliberately rather than by default — the unfiltered view is the one that shows the holder's personas side by side.

changedSince.description: Return only contacts whose current revision was received after this instant. Annotation changes do not count: they are the holder's own and need no "what changed while I was away".

starred.description: `true`: only starred contacts. `false`: only unstarred ones. Absent: both.

listId.description: Only contacts on this list. A list this context does not hold is `listUnknown`, not an empty page, because a list identifier is the holder's own and its absence is a definite answer worth giving.

directoryVtcDid.description: Only contacts whose `directoryRef` names this community. What the holder's own client asks for when it joins that community's directory with the holder's contacts, locally.

Response.title: Persona Contact List — response payload
Response.description: Success response to persona/contact/list. Type https://trusttasks.org/spec/persona/contact/list/1.1#response. Summaries carry no claim values: a list is for finding a contact, and finding one does not require disclosing every contact's details. They do carry the holder's own annotations, which a client needs to sort, badge and filter, and which go to no one but the holder's own client.

displayName.description: A rendering hint drawn from the contact's own disclosed display-name claim, so a list is legible. Absent when they disclosed none; a producer MUST NOT substitute the DID — or the petname — silently as though it were the contact's own name.

hasUnreviewedChange.description: True when the current revision superseded another and the holder has not yet acknowledged the difference.

starred.description: Whether the holder starred the contact. Always present.
